CustomField.label: Billing Frequency
CustomField.description: Quote-level billing frequency. The pricing procedure (context attribute MbQuoteBillingFrequency) applies it to every recurring quote line's Billing Frequency and the billing frequency discount. Blank: each line keeps its own.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Applies to every recurring line on the quote when the quote is priced. Leave blank to set it per line.
